Skip to main content (Press Enter). | Login to see members only content | Skip auxiliary navigation (Press Enter). | Contact Us | CoreNet Global | Knowledge Center | Policies | Skip main navigation (Press Enter). | Toggle navigation | Message from the President |  | Welcome to CoreNet South East Florida Chapter’s Web Page.  Our South East Florida Chapter serves one of the most exciting and active RE markets in the nation.  Our chapter also holds a newly seated board of directors.  Our board are CRE professionals from Avison Young, Derektor, Iron Mountain, DHL, Tarkett, Bank of America and Macro Group.  |  | We're working on new events, educational content, mixers and networking opportunities for 2024.  |  | The new board remains steadfast in advancing the practice of corporate real estate in South Florida through professional development opportunities, publications, research, conferences and networking groups.  We aim to serve as the profession's voice and thought leader.  |  | We are a non-profit association, representing Corporate Real Estate Executives, Service Providers and Economic Development Organizations involved in activities related to real estate assets of large corporations. Our interaction allows for the End-Users to share best practices, go about common challenges and exchange comments on their Service Providers.  For the latter, the Chapter allows one to approach prospects and clients in a friendly ambiance, getting to know each other better.  EDO´s can showcase their respective regions and advantages to set foot in them.  In all, it is a win-win organization, where everybody gets value, grows their network, learning and having fun at the same time.  |  | It is an exciting time to be a practitioner of Corporate Real Estate in South Florida, where the region is experiencing tremendous growth and change.  We welcome you to join us at our events that are designed to help you learn, connect and grow.  Should you have any comments or questions, feel free to reach out to any of us on the board.  We will be happy to help you navigate our organization and get the most out of it.  |  | Best regards, |  | Hector Gualda  - President |  |  |  |  |  |  | Home | About | CoreNet Global | Mission | Membership | Join | Renew | Membership Benefits | Directory | Leadership | Chapter Leaders | Young Leaders | Message from the President | My Profile | Career Resources | Resources | Chapter Documents | Blogs | Library | Discussion Group | Events | Our Events | National Calendar | Past Events - Photos and Presentations | Press Releases | Copyright © Southeast Florida Chapter.
